title: symbolic user functions: flat evaluation of vector and matrix operations
author: Claude-JG
description: After the scalar expressions: the vector and matrix operation nodes (sums, products, transposes, components of a computed vector or matrix) become operations of the flat list as well, so that a shared vector or matrix node is computed once per evaluation; same tests and text export.
releaseNotes: Symbolic user functions evaluate their vector and matrix operations by the list of operations as well: a shared vector or matrix is computed once per call; userRigidBodyTest.py with 10000 steps: 2.72 s with the tree, 0.75 s with the list (revision2026c step RG12.2.7)
